name: 讲解员C
appearance_en: a Chinese woman in her late thirties with a short dark bob haircut and thin round metal-framed glasses, wearing a muted sage-green blouse with a small stand collar and a keyhole neckline, tiny stud earrings; warm, experienced and approachable, with a bright, expressive face and a kind gaze
scene_en: one cozy, warm small-group writing classroom with cream walls, light wood furniture, green plants and bright airy daylight from a side window; it has three areas: a light wood writing table with open lined notebooks, pencils and a small potted plant; a tall warm wooden bookshelf full of colorful children's books; and a reading corner with a soft cream fabric armchair, an arched brass floor lamp and a small round side table with a short stack of books
voice_en: a calm, clear mid-pitched female Mandarin voice

actions.lean_in: leans slightly toward the camera as if sharing something important
actions.open_palm: raises one hand at chest height with an open palm in a gentle explaining gesture
actions.count: counts off on the fingers of one hand at chest height
actions.smile: breaks into a warm, reassuring smile
actions.tilt_head: tilts the head slightly with a thoughtful, questioning look
actions.pull_book: pulls a colorful picture book halfway out of the shelf, glances at it and smiles
actions.hold_notebook: lifts an open lined notebook from the table and tilts it toward the camera, the page showing only faint lines with no readable writing
actions.lean_desk: leans forward on the table with both forearms, as if chatting with a parent across it
actions.sit_down: settles into the chair at the table with a relaxed smile

desk.en: sitting at the light wood writing table, leaning slightly forward toward the camera, open lined notebooks just below the frame

bookshelf.en: standing close in front of the tall wooden bookshelf, colorful book spines softly blurred behind her shoulders

armchair.en: sitting relaxed in the soft cream armchair in the reading corner, the warm glow of the arched floor lamp behind her
